issue.title: Use the LibYAML C loader for configuration reads
issue.description: Deferred by epic bead sase-en in plans:202608/bead_show_speed.md; not caused by that epic. PyYAML's C loader is available, but configuration paths still use yaml.safe_load and the pure-Python loader. On src/sase/default_config.yml, 100 integrated-tree parses average 40.683 ms with safe_load versus 3.162 ms with yaml.CSafeLoader (12.9x faster). Scope: inventory JSON-shaped trusted configuration reads, introduce a safe C-loader path with a portable fallback when LibYAML is unavailable, preserve parsing/error behavior, and add parity coverage before migrating eligible call sites.
